text:
tay.devex: quick sync — sample-apps users keep hitting "fetch is not defined" on older node images. want to finalise guidance for the JS SDK.
noah.sdk: TLDR: prefer native/global fetch when present; provide a tiny injection API so apps can opt-in a shim without global mutation.
arjun.infra: prefer injection over global monkeypatch in infra. makes container images and bundlers more predictable. Also doc recommended node matrix and undici version for old nodes.
lucy.prod: onboarding needs copy-paste snippets. users paste from quickstart; keep it 3 lines max. we should also include a one-line fix for the "fetch is not defined" case.
tay.devex: proposal: export setFetchImplementation(fetchFn) and hasGlobalFetch(). also export a FetchLike type. add a helper useUndiciForNode() in examples (not in core) so users can opt into undici easily.
noah.sdk: implementation notes: SDK internal network layer will call `getFetch()` that returns either the injected fn or globalThis.fetch. We'll normalise the response shape for older undici versions.
arjun.infra: callout: undici stream/abort semantics differ across v4/v5; recommend undici@^5 in docs and in our sample-app package.json. CI should run matrix on node 16/18/20.
lucy.prod: snippets for quickstart (copy-paste):
```js
// ESM (Node <18) - minimal
import { fetch as undiciFetch } from 'undici'
import { setFetchImplementation } from '@redwood/inference'
setFetchImplementation(undiciFetch)
```
```js
// CJS (Node <18) - minimal
const { fetch: undiciFetch } = require('undici')
const { setFetchImplementation } = require('@redwood/inference')
setFetchImplementation(undiciFetch)
```
tay.devex: also include one-line global shim for folks who want the fastest fix (with bundler caveat): `if (!globalThis.fetch) globalThis.fetch = (await import('undici')).fetch`
noah.sdk: retry/auth note: different fetch implementations handle streaming and AbortController differently. We'll implement an internal retry wrapper that only retries safe methods by default (GET/HEAD) and expose hooks for custom retry logic and token refresh.
arjun.infra: add tests covering streaming responses with undici in CI. I can add node 16/18/20 runners.
lucy.prod: troubleshooting table for quickstart:
- "fetch is not defined" -> run the ESM/CJS snippet or apply the one-line shim
- "stream aborted mid-response" -> try switching to the native edge runtime or update undici to latest
- "401 then retry breaks stream" -> enable SDK token refresh hook and disable POST retries for streaming endpoints
qa-bot: ci:tests triggered by @noah.sdk — 2 failures in http-client-compat.
noah.sdk: i'll pick up the failing tests; likely need to normalise body streams for older undici. will open PR with: setFetchImplementation, hasGlobalFetch, FetchLike typedef, small retry wrapper, and quickstart edits.
tay.devex: thanks — i'll update docs and sample-apps once PR lands. aim to keep quickstart language simple to reduce support tickets. :thumbsup:
